caseNameFull: Gilligan, Governor of Ohio v. Morgan

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 409 U. S. 947.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae on behalf of petitioners granted and 15 minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
